product_family: Investor relationship / private-markets platform for founders and VCs. Founder side: fundraising pipelines, pitch decks, data rooms, investor updates. Investor side: portfolio monitoring, LP reporting, fund dashboards, and an AI/MCP layer (AI Inbox, AI Updates, AI Docs, MCP Server) for connecting portfolio data to LLMs.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: Visible is SOC 2 certified, performs regular penetration testing, and 24/7 continuous monitoring.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not mentioned on any vendor-domain page (for-investors, for-founders, ai-mcp-server, gdpr, privacy, dpa, subprocessor-list) as of this review.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance, Business Associate Agreement, or healthcare-specific controls anywhere on visible.vc. Product is positioned for startup/VC fundraising and portfolio monitoring, not healthcare data.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: We have appointed a Data Protection Officer to oversee our GDPR compliance efforts. ... Visible may transfer your data to countries outside the European Economic Area using appropriate safeguards when necessary.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Visible does not receive your credit card, debit card or other financial information (payments are redirected to Stripe); no PCI DSS attestation is claimed by Visible itself since it does not directly handle cardholder data.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No AI-governance-specific certification mentioned on any vendor page despite the product shipping AI features (AI Inbox, AI Updates, AI Docs, MCP Server).

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR registration or certification on any vendor-domain page.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; product is not marketed to US federal government customers.

privacy.ai_training_note: Terms of Service define 'Benchmark Data' as statistical, system, usage, and configuration data that is 'aggregated, de-identified, or anonymized,' and grant Visible 'the right to use Benchmark Data to develop modifications, improvements, and enhancements to the Visible Platform.' This only clearly covers aggregated/de-identified data, not raw customer content. Neither the Privacy Policy, Terms, nor the AI/MCP product page state whether raw customer content (decks, updates, financials) is used to train or fine-tune AI models, and no opt-out mechanism for AI features is described. The product actively markets AI features (AI Inbox parses financials/decks/emails) without a published AI-data-use policy covering raw customer content.
privacy.data_region: Personal Information may be transferred to, stored in, and processed in the United States. Subprocessor list shows AWS and Heroku (both US-based cloud hosts) as primary hosting/storage providers. EU/UK/Switzerland transfers are governed by SCCs per the DPA.

security.name: SOC 2 status
security.value: SOC 2 certified per vendor's own marketing copy; SOC 2 is technically an attestation report from a licensed CPA firm rather than a formal 'certification,' though Visible's own site uses the word 'certified.' Report and auditor name, and Type 1 vs Type 2, are not disclosed on any public vendor page.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: All data sent to or from Visible is encrypted using TLS 1.2.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: All customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Regular penetration testing performed (frequency/vendor not disclosed).

security.name: Secure SDLC
security.value: Code changes are automatically scanned for vulnerabilities, peer-reviewed, and tested against automated test suites.

security.name: Backups
security.value: Regular backups are stored separately from the backend infrastructure.

security.name: DPA / sub-processor transparency
security.value: Published Data Processing Addendum and a public sub-processor list (AWS, Heroku, Twilio/Segment, Twilio/Sendgrid, Intercom, HubSpot, Stripe, Google, Honeybadger, Zoom).

products.name: Visible for Founders (Starter/Base/Core/Growth plans)
products.data_scope: Pitch decks, cap table-adjacent metrics, investor contact data, data rooms, investor updates.
products.notes: Self-serve, credit-card signup, tiered pricing from free (Starter) to $199-249/mo (Growth).

products.name: Visible for Investors (Essential/Premium/Enterprise plans)
products.data_scope: Portfolio company financials and KPIs, fund performance data, LP reporting data, benchmark data across portfolio.
products.notes: Contact-for-pricing tiers; Enterprise adds API access and custom SLA/MSA. Premium/Enterprise add AI Inbox (parses emails/financials/decks).

products.name: AI / MCP Server
products.data_scope: Connects Visible's portfolio/company data to external LLMs via Model Context Protocol; AI Inbox parses financials, decks, and emails.
products.notes: No published AI-training or AI-data-retention policy was found; how customer content sent through AI features is used remains undocumented by Visible.

compare.pricing_model: Tiered SaaS subscription: self-serve free-to-paid plans for founders ($0-$249/mo), contact-sales tiers for investors/VC funds.
compare.data_residency: United States (AWS/Heroku hosting); EU/UK/Swiss transfers via Standard Contractual Clauses.

flags: No dedicated trust center or standalone security page exists; SOC 2, encryption, and monitoring claims are stated only as marketing copy on the /for-investors/ and /for-founders/ landing pages, with no auditor name, report type (Type 1 vs Type 2), or report date disclosed. This certification is vendor-self-reported, without a downloadable report or named auditor.

AI features (AI Inbox, AI Updates, AI Docs, MCP Server) are actively marketed, but there is no published policy on whether customer content is used to train or improve AI models beyond the generic 'Benchmark Data' (aggregated/de-identified) clause in the Terms of Service.

Several unrelated companies use similar names, including Visible Network Labs, Visible.be, Visibility Corporation, Visible Alpha, and VisiblePrivacy (visibleprivacy.com). This report covers Visible.vc only.
